$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-A-NON-VOID-FUNCTION-WHOSE-END-IS-REACHABLE-IS-REFUSED): C23 6.9.2p13 makes REACHING the closing brace of a function that returns a value defined — only USING the value nobody returned is undefined. DSS refused every such function (H_VerifierFailure, 'may fall through without returning a value'); it now compiles it, a call that ends at the brace RETURNS to a caller that goes on running, and the function is reported once as a warning at the brace (H_NonVoidFunctionEndReachable). The rule is language config: `nonVoidFunctionEndReached: returnsUnspecifiedValue` on C's `topLevelDecl` row; a document that does not state the key keeps the refusal. Exit 42, or a bitmask of the shapes that went wrong (see main.c): 1 = `if (k) return 5;` reached twice unused then returned and used, 2 = an enumeration switch with a return per case and no default, 4 = no return statement at all, 8 = pointer / double / long double / a two-word structure / a 64-byte structure (the caller's storage), each reached unused then returned and compared, 16 = the same bodies where the release pipeline may inline them. REFERENCES: see `$measuredComment`.
$measuredComment: MEASURED 2026-10-10 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, on THIS source byte for byte (main.c, md5 be6032c7d037a685a660863886e2ee27), each reference at its strict dialect and at its newest (`-std=c17 -pedantic-errors` and `-std=c2x`; cl `/std:c17` and `/std:clatest`), with its default warnings: EVERY reference compiles it and the program exits 42 — a reached end is accepted by all, and a call that ends there returns to a caller that goes on. Who SAYS so by default: cl 19.51 reports all ten functions (C4715 for nine, C4716 for `no_return`), at the ten closing-brace lines `expectWarnings` names (the action's report 20261010-184524-beb5e7c4); clang 18.1.3 (report 20261010-184451-e6b04c9a, which also holds gcc's) and Apple clang 21.0.0 (20261010-184536-513767b0) report nine at the same lines — all but `per_case`, the enumeration switch that returns in every case; gcc 13.3.0 and mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 (20261010-184519-f98e4768) say nothing by default, and reported the ten under `-Wall` on these same bytes on 2026-10-08. This compiler reports the ten, as cl does.
$releaseComment: The release arm is the half the ruling asks for by name: under the optimizer a function in which SOME paths return and one reaches the end keeps its returning paths' values (`some_paths(1) == 5`, `inl_some_paths(1) == 5` after inlining), and the reached end is neither deleted as unreachable (the `steps` counter says the statements after each such call ran) nor allowed to change another path. REPORT-ONLY (`mustDifferFromBaseline: false`): its value is that the optimized program agrees.
$commentRedOnDisable: WRITTEN, NOT READ — no mutation named here has been built and read, and this example is a corpus check, never a pin. The claims are unit TESTs of tests/hir/test_non_void_function_end_reached.cpp (`NonVoidFunctionEndReached.TheBodyIsCompletedAndTheFunctionReportedOnce`, `.EveryResultClassIsCompletedWithALocalOfItsOwnType`, `.OneWarningPerFunctionAtItsOwnClosingBrace`, `.MainKeepsItsImplicitReturnZeroAndIsNotReported`, and one case per route that completes an end). Each mutation is to be an arm of tests/mutations/arms.registry, and proves its claim when that arm reads `passed`. Until then this is a PREDICTION from the code, not a measurement — the failure modes that would discriminate: the completion removed (every function here is refused — the compile fails), the reached end lowered as unreachable (bit 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16: control runs past the function), the completion applied to `main` first (seen by that unit file, not by this example: `main` here returns explicitly).
